messages:
cara: Heads-up — planning a base-image compaction + re-sign Tuesday 09:00 PT. Need RBAC for the signing principal, audit sink confirmation, and a short canary plan.
jun: +1. Do we have a KMS key that's already used for cosign? ops wants the exact service principal list.
oliver: There's an existing cryptoKey in projects/prod-kms (named base-image-key). It currently allows serviceAccount:ci-signer@redwood. We'll need a separate principal for the rebuild pipeline.
remy: For least privilege, propose an ephemeral SA with only cloudkms.signerVerifier on that key, TTL 48h. Avoid widening the CI signer.
cara: Agreed. Proposal: create kms-rebuild-signer-<runid> SA with 48h TTL, update pipeline to use KMS KeyVersion signing (no local private keys), and forward key use logs to sec-audit.
jun: I'll own the IAM PR but need the exact member list and the terraform snippet.
oliver: I'll draft terraform to create the service account and bind roles/cloudkms.signerVerifier to the key. We should use a condition to limit by resource name and only allow keyVersion: sign.
remy: Audit retention: admin activity 365d, data plane/key use 90d by default, but forward to immutable GCS for at least 1 year for rebuild provenance. Need sec approval.
ops-oncall: Runtime constraints: new compact images must pass image-compat-check (syscall whitelist, seccomp, no setuid, compatible glibc), plus runtime-health job. Canary must auto rollback on health regressions.
security-bot: POLICY CHECK: IAM change touches /policies/kms-signing; approval required from sec-owners. Auto-attach: /policies/kms-signing/approval-checklist.md
cara: My checklist: 1) create ephemeral SA & IAM binding 2) update KMS key policy for KeyVersion signing 3) switch CI to KMS cosign flow 4) configure audit sink -> sec-audit GCS 5) run image-compat-check & vuln-scan 6) canary (10% -> 50% -> 100%) with rollback 7) post-roll audit review.
jun: Terraform snippet I'll use:
```
resource "google_service_account" "kms_rebuild_signer" {
  account_id   = "kms-rebuild-signer-1718"
  display_name = "Ephemeral KMS signer for base rebuild"
}
resource "google_kms_crypto_key_iam_binding" "signer" {
  crypto_key_id = var.base_image_key
  role          = "roles/cloudkms.signerVerifier"
  members       = ["serviceAccount:${google_service_account.kms_rebuild_signer.email}"]
}
```
oliver: Ping when PR is ready. I'll add a condition expression limiting the binding to the specific key resource and include a cloudasset export to capture the change.
remy: Attestation: pipeline should emit an in-toto statement + cosign bundle to gs://rebuild-provenance/<runid>/ and trigger sbom-indexer. That provenance must be immutable and tied to the audit log.
cara: Yes — we'll block signing until vuln-scan is green. If any CVE >= High shows up, we hold and escalate.
ops-oncall: Canary plan: 30min stabilization per step, checks: p99 latency, error rate <0.5%, startup time, and cold-cache tail. On failure: alert @ops-oncall and auto rollback to previous signed image.
jun: Note: some older nodes use older glibc; run image-compat-check across matrix before signing. Also keep the previous signed variant available for instant rollback.
remy: For incident response, add a rollover path: separate cosign-rollback SA with very narrow permission + documented private-key fallback in vault with two-person approval. Link runbook: /runbooks/image-rollbacks.md
cara: Action items: Jun - PR IAM + cloudasset export; Oliver - verify condition expressions & terraform apply window; Remy - wire provenance upload & sbom index trigger; Ops - run compat-job and configure canary policy; Security - signoff on audit retention and IAM.
ops-oncall: I'll schedule the rollout window and arrange ephemeral SA rotation and paging.
jun: PR opened: https://git.redwood/sre/infra/pulls/432 — includes terraform, cloudasset export, and approval request.
oliver: Reviewed, left comments on condition expression and least-privilege scope. Small nit on naming.
remy: Also recommend running a focused vulnerability triage pre-roll (automated scan + quick manual review) and capture findings in the JIRA ticket.
cara: We'll block signing until triage is clear. If needed, we delay the rollout and notify customers.
security-bot: REMINDER: create JIRA ticket tag KMS-SIGN-1718 and attach audit-sink link.
cara: Thanks all — will gather approvals tomorrow 08:30 PT and update the thread. :thumbsup:
